Mohsen Baqery is a Staff Writer at GameRant based in Turkey. He primarily covers video game news while occasionally writing guides and listicles. Mohsen began his journey in video game journalism by self-publishing game reviews on platforms like LevelSkip (HubPages) and his own Medium profile. This eventually led to freelance opportunities with smaller online publications and marked the beginning of his professional writing career. His work has also been featured on MSN, IMDb, and OpenCritic.
Resident Evil 4. He still remembers the thrill of taking down zombies with the Red9. The original release, not the remake, will always be his go-to TPS. Other favorite games: Back to the Dawn, Stardew Valley, Indigo Prophecy, Heavy Rain, and GTA 5.
These days, Mohsen is more of a go-with-the-flow gamer who doesn't worry too much about achievements. But there's one thing he is proud of: he's beaten the original RE4 more than 17 times and could practically play it blindfolded.
Mohsen primarily covers indie game news, with a particular focus on titles released on Steam. He also has a passion for the latest scientific research on games and gamers, which he frequently explores in his articles. Mohsen is also one of GameRant's dedicated freebie hunters, keeping readers informed about worthwhile gaming deals as soon as they become available. When he's not covering the latest news, he can often be found writing game guides for titles he enjoys.
